parameters.question: Compare factor loading tables from Factor Analysis (number of factors chosen by parallel analysis, 100 iterations, 95th percentile, random_state=42). Each survey item's loading on each factor must match the reference within +/-0.05. The sign of a whole factor may be flipped, factor column order may differ, and item label formatting may differ (e.g., case or prefixes). Match items by row label and factors by best-matching loading pattern (allowing sign flip) before comparing values.
